title: Five personal AoT CLI application implementations
constraints: Ground each application in observed session history or durable memory
Represent implementation as executable DAG JSON and human project guide
Use dry-run tracker previews by default
No mutation of user vaults, PageIndex, Linear, or br trackers during design
After critical review, promote prose-only safety requirements into executable DAG gates

nodes.title: Mine session and memex history
nodes.content: Identify repeated user workflows, failure modes, and durable context from session_search and memex recall.

nodes.title: Select five nuanced applications
nodes.content: Prefer applications that combine existing user tools with AoT DAG semantics: dependencies, constraints, entailments, dry-runs, and validation loops.

nodes.title: Run one bounded reviewer per application
nodes.content: Use isolated read-only subagents to critique each application for assumptions, missing gates, and self-improvement lessons.

nodes.title: ANZCA SAQ Syntopical Model-Answer Factory
nodes.content: Examiner-fit answer sets with explicit dry-run, evidence, citation, regression, and replay gates

nodes.title: PageIndex R2L Evidence Crosswalk and PDF Ingestion
nodes.content: Safe ingestion with async R2L readiness, idempotency, manifest validation, and rollback/reconcile paths

nodes.title: MAK95 MCQ Five-Gate Closure and Cluster Governance
nodes.content: Identity-preserving closure with route-specific branching and bounded validation retries

nodes.title: Memex Agentic Memory Graph Maintenance Loop
nodes.content: Memory graph maintenance with baseline, deduplication, scoped sync, and post-sync verification

nodes.title: Agent Tooling Release Orchestrator
nodes.content: Release orchestration with split verification, remote hygiene, scoped commits, and durable learning capture

nodes.title: Validate runnable DAG examples
nodes.content: Run aot dag --dryRun over every example and test parse/normalize/render behavior.

safety.rollbackPlan: Restore from checkpoint artifact or stop with a partial-failure manifest if not reversible.

nodes.title: Publish implementation and critical evaluation guide
nodes.content: Write guides explaining applications, critiques, self-improvement principles, validation, and rollout sequencing.
